name: Pixel Life Wallpaper
description:
A living pixel-art wallpaper in a cozy retro style. A village by the lake, a big city, the countryside, a medieval market town, outer space or a dome under the sea, with lights going on and off in the windows, people, pets, traffic, trains, weather and a day and night cycle that follows your clock. Everything happens at random, so it never repeats. Optional clock overlay (info box, digital or analog).

The animation pauses while a window is maximized or the screen is locked.
